functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth_passkey_enable_mfa()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE users SET two_factor_enabled=true WHERE id=NEW."userId";
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
